title: Item 32: Split Monolithic CSS into Component Files

inputs.description: Split the 2900+ line monolithic App.css into component-level CSS files. (1) Create individual CSS files: SearchPanel.css, MapView.css, AlertBanner.css, ShelterPopup.css, AppHeader.css, EmergencyButton.css, Onboarding.css, ErrorBoundary.css, LocationInput.css, SearchHistory.css, TravelModeSelector.css, and keep App.css for only global styles, CSS variables, and reset/base styles, (2) Move the relevant CSS blocks from App.css to each component file, (3) Import the CSS file in each component (e.g., import './SearchPanel.css' in SearchPanel.tsx), (4) Keep all CSS variables/custom properties in App.css as they are global, (5) Ensure no visual changes - this is a pure refactor. Test that all styles still apply correctly.
inputs.title: Split Monolithic CSS into Component Files
